thread:
Jules (Vendor Ops): AuroraMesh sent invoice AM-0520 for $12,500 and asked if Redwood can pay via international wire or crypto. They also asked whether to send W-9 or W-8BEN-E and if Redwood will gross-up for withholding. Invoice: https://files.redwood/auroramesh/invoice-0520.pdf

Nora (Finance): Payment rails don't change tax docs. Need to confirm invoicing legal entity. SG-registered companies use GST (IRAS) not VAT. If invoiced from a US entity -> W-9. Non-US -> W-8BEN-E. Also ask vendor to clarify GST ID and whether they charge GST or expect reverse-charge (unlikely for SG).

Ethan (Tax): Also clarify the nature of the fees (service/subscription vs royalty). Royalties = potential withholding. Gross-up is exceptional and must be contractually agreed. For Singapore entities, we generally don't withhold on B2B services if not US-sourced. If they invoice from a US LLC, they need W-9 and we may need TIN verification to avoid backup withholding.

Jules (Vendor Ops): Invoice header pasted:
```
Invoice: AM-2026-0520
Seller: AuroraMesh Pte Ltd
Registered in: Singapore
GST Reg: 202405678K
Alternate billing: AuroraMesh LLC (US)
Payment terms: 30d - wire/BTC
Description: Monthly inference credits
```

Sam (AP): Placing hold: HOLD_REASON=TAX_DOCS_REQUIRED. Request vendor to provide: 1) Certificate of Incorporation for invoicing entity; 2) GST registration verification (IRAS screenshot) if SG GST claimed; 3) completed W-8BEN-E or W-9 as applicable; 4) explicit statement that charges are for services (not royalties); 5) bank name / crypto wallet legal name for reconciliation. CC ap-docs@redwood on upload.

Ravi (AuroraMesh): Hi all  we are AuroraMesh Pte Ltd (SG). GST line was added automatically; we're not charging GST for exports to foreign business customers, but some invoices show the GST Reg no by default. We bill from SG entity; founders have US residency but company is Singapore. Regarding gross-up: our finance ops asked if Redwood would gross-up if any US withholding applied because founders are US citizens and funds route through the US for FX. We prefer not to take withholding risk.

tax-checker-bot: IRAS check: GST Reg 202405678K -> STATUS: VALID (checked 2026-05-20 11:02 UTC).

Ethan (Tax): Thanks Ravi. If invoiced by AuroraMesh Pte Ltd (SG) and they confirm charges are services exported to a business customer, withholding is not typical. Provide: (a) incorporation extract for Pte Ltd; (b) IRAS GST verification or screenshot showing status; (c) completed W-8BEN-E (we require this from non-US payees receiving US-sourced income) 5 even though services are delivered from SG, it helps documentation; (d) line item wording 5 "monthly inference credits / platform subscription". Gross-up: not standard; we won't gross-up unless contractually agreed.

Nora (Finance): Action items for vendor: reissue or confirm invoice shows AuroraMesh Pte Ltd (SG) as invoicing entity, attach incorporation extract + IRAS GST verification if GST shown, and upload completed W-8BEN-E. AP will release hold after docs verified.

Sam (AP): Noted. I'll release hold when ap-docs receives the ZIP: invoice + incorporation + GST proof + W-8BEN-E.

Ravi (AuroraMesh): We'll reissue with explicit non-GST line and upload docs by EOD. We accept no gross-up. Thanks.

Ethan (Tax): Perfect. If anything looks like royalties after review, we'll reach out, otherwise we should be clear to pay once docs present. :thumbsup:

Nora (Finance): Thanks team. Jules please update thread when docs appear in ap-docs.
